observations: Photocopier wrapped tightly in clear plastic film, closed lid up
Sharp brand logo and 'AR-M207' model name visible on front panel, photo 0 and photo 1
'digital' logo badge on side panel, photo 1
Paper size labels 'A4' and 'A3' visible on side trays, photo 1
Machine sits on wooden pallet/crate in what looks like a warehouse or storage yard
No power-on screen, no display panel, no page counter visible in any photo
No photo of internal drum, toner cartridge, or control panel up close
Unit fully wrapped, cannot see scratches, vents, or rollers underneath wrap
Seller's new message is text only, no new photo or video supplied

claims.evidence: No import sticker, UK plug, or voltage label visible in any photo

claims.claim: Packed with extensive range of superb performance functions
claims.evidence: Generic marketing text, not shown or provable from photos
No counter display or service sticker shown in any photo; seller's verbal reassurance is not photographic proof

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: No open panel or new part photo showing drum/toner unit; seller's claim of testing is not visual proof
No power-on or test print photo provided; 'I tested it myself' is a claim, not evidence

risks.risk: Machine may not power on or may have internal fault
risks.proof: Video of unit powered on, displaying ready screen and producing a test copy

risks.risk: Actual page count could be much higher than claimed
risks.proof: Photo of the counter/report page showing total impression count
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown high-use unit, worst case

risks.risk: Drum/toner condition unverified, could be worn despite claim
risks.proof: Photo of drum and toner unit removed, showing new part labels/date

risks.risk: Physical condition (scratches, cracks, missing parts) hidden by plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos with wrap fully removed, all sides and glass visible

risks.risk: Voltage/plug mismatch if genuinely ex-UK machine
risks.proof: Photo of rating plate showing voltage spec and plug type
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible conversion cost needed

proof_requests: Video of machine powered on producing a test print/copy
Photo of the built-in page counter or a printed counter report
Photo of drum and toner unit removed showing part condition/date codes
Photos with all plastic wrap removed, all sides and top glass visible
Photo of the rating/serial plate showing voltage and manufacture date
response.reason: A verbal reassurance with no new photo or video does not change any verdict; the model is identified but functional claims remain unverified and the unit stays fully wrapped, so a worst-case price still needs at least one proof shot such as a power-on test before it can be judged working.
